description:
Circa 1920s-30s - Length: 2-3/4”
The Cap & Barrel: The engraving reads "18KT - 1/10 GOLD FILLED". This indicates a high-grade manufacturing process where a thick layer of solid 18-karat gold is mechanically bonded to a base metal core. In the 1920s, a 1/10 fractional ratio was exceptionally generous, meaning 10% of the total overlay metal's weight is true gold (more common vintage pens often used a thinner 1/20 ratio).\n• The Nib: The stamp confirms it is a solid 14-karat gold nib. Nibs from this era especially those coming from former Waterman craftsmen are highly celebrated among modern collectors for their impressive smoothness and flexible expression.

Vintage Hemingray glass telegraph/telephone pole insulator in aqua/teal blue color. Features embossed 'HEMINGRAY-42' lettering and beaded skirt design around the base. Includes original wrought iron pole mounting peg/pin with wood-covered threaded shaft, used to attach the insulator to utility poles. Both pieces show age-appropriate wear consistent with antique railroad/telegraph line hardware, including surface rust on the iron peg and natural glass wear with embedded dirt. Authentic antique collectible pairing a Hemingray glass insulator with its matching iron pin. Popular among insulator and telegraphiana collectors.

description: Large polished blue agate geode specimen featuring natural rough edges and a polished flat viewing face. The stone displays striking blue and white banding with a mix of translucent and opaque areas, showcasing characteristic concentric agate patterns. This is a natural mineral specimen with no visible brand markings. The piece is in used condition with markings and natural cracking. Suitable for display, bookend, or paperweight use. Natural mineral collectible.

description: This lot includes four vintage used vacuum tubes from National brand: 2C39 and 7289 models. Made in the USA, these tubes feature metal and ceramic construction. They were typically used as radio frequency power amplifiers in industrial, military, and amateur radio equipment. Tubes show signs of wear and oxidation, with handwritten notes on bases indicating previous use and condition, such as 'R. Final 2C39 5-20-85 USED' and '+V.G.++'. All tubes appear structurally intact but are sold as used and may require testing or refurbishment before operational use. Suitable for collectors, restorers, or those needing period-correct replacements for vintage RF or transmitter gear. not tested

Lot of 2 Great Big Bag Mining + Geode Slice Noble Stone
Lot of two 'Great Big Bag' Awesome Mining Rough gemstone and fossil kits from The Noble Stone (Amana, Iowa). Each cotton drawstring bag contains 8oz of gemstones, an arrowhead, crystal point, shark's teeth, 15 fossils, and a surprise item.
Also included is a large polished agate/crystal geode slice with banded gray and brown exterior and sparkling quartz crystal interior, approximately fist-sized.
Loose contents include an assortment of small polished stones, mineral chunks, tumbled gemstones, fossilized shark teeth, fossil shells, and river rocks in various colors: white, orange, green, gray, and brown.
Items appear new and unused. Sold as a novelty educational rockhounding and fossil collection set.

description:
Natural Amethyst Cathedral Geode
Standing Quartz Crystal Cluster Specimen
Deep Purple Quartz, Approximately 6.8 Inches Tall, 3.6 Pounds
This natural amethyst cathedral geode specimen features a cavity of vibrant, deep purple crystalline quartz points bordered by a banded agate perimeter and a natural rock matrix. Cut with a flat base, it stands freely for display on a tabletop, shelf, or mineral cabinet. Natural amethyst geodes form within volcanic cavities, creating striking geological display pieces highly prized by mineral collectors and interior decorators alike.
Features dense, lustrous purple quartz crystal points inside an open geode cavity
Natural rock exterior with cut flat base for stable, upright display
Polished boundary rim highlights the transition from matrix to crystal cluster
Measures approximately 6.8 inches tall by 4.2 inches wide; weighs approximately 3.6 pounds
Condition:
Excellent natural mineral condition. Crystal points are sharp, vibrant, and well-formed with deep violet coloration. Natural surface variations, internal fissures, and rough textures inherent to geological specimens are present on the matrix back and sides. Cut base is flat and stable.

.

delivered

Combined shipping

The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

shipping.policy:
We are NOT responsible for packages lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. You will need to handle your own claims through the associated shipping carrier. We can provide necessary documentation if requested.
Items from our location will ship within 5-7 business days from the time payment is received. Our hours of operation are Monday through Friday from approximately 7am-3pm EST.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
All other items may be combined for payment and shipping if they are from the same Goodwill location, close within 7 days of each other, are not marked as Cannot Be Combined For Shipping, do not exceed 20 lbs in combined weight and are being shipped via the same carrier.
To combine eligible auction items into one order, you must wait until all of the items have ended before paying.
Once the auctions have ended, please sign into your ShopGoodwill.com account and proceed to your Open Orders. Click on the Pay link next to one of the items, all auction items that may be eligible for combination will then be displayed. Click on the box next to each item and follow the instructions to complete your payment.
Once payment has been made for an item, it cannot be combined with another item won at a later date. If you have won an item and expect to win another from the same seller and wish to combine all items, you must postpone payment until you have won the second item (third, fourth item, etc.) but not exceeding 7 days from the closing date of the first item.
Due to the fragility and size and/or weight of certain items, the seller may not offer combined shipping for certain items. Please be sure to read all item descriptions carefully for any other item combination restrictions.
Items that have been paid for will be shipped to the address on file and will not be able to be modified or combined. Address changes, shipping cost adjustments, and/or alternative packaging requests MUST be submitted prior to payment. PO Boxes can be added to your profile address if one of our shipping carriers does not deliver to your physical address. We cannot edit profiles; please be sure this is done prior to making any purchases. Alternative packaging requests are subject to an additional fee where applicable.
In the event of an unclaimed pickup order, or a returned package, the customer will need to pay an additional shipping charge to re-ship the order. Under NO circumstances will a refund be given for said unclaimed/returned packages.
Any and all changes/adjustments MUST be made PRIOR to payment! Adjustments WILL NOT be made after a payment has been submitted. This location is closed on weekends & holidays. We may not be able to get to your support ticket right away. Please plan in advance.

description:
Assorted Mineral and Crystal Specimens Quartz Geode Points Polished Stone 6x6
Collection of assorted mineral and crystal specimens including a large white quartz geode with crystalline interior, several quartz points with iridescent surfaces, a rough beige stone, a polished reddish-brown stone, and a geode slice with a shimmering surface. Most pieces are natural and unpolished, featuring clear crystal formations and slight golden inclusions. Condition is good with minor natural imperfections typical of mineral specimens. No brand or manufacturer markings present. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or metaphysical purposes.
